title: NetSuRF M3.1 replicated estimator measurements
null_representation: empty CSV field for explicitly nullable values

empirical_bits.csv.sampling: inclusion_rule and sampling_probability identify all, uniform, or conditional-stratified selection

estimator_predictions.csv.semantics: raw score and optional signed prediction

estimator_agreement.csv.semantics: pairwise score correlation, exact score/order equality, rank shifts, and top-10 overlap

trials.csv.independent_unit: fault schedule within replication and logical-BER condition; policy labels encode BER for multi-BER studies

estimator_runtime.csv.warning: shared per-example Jacobian time is repeated for dependent estimator rows and must not be summed
